parent_overlap_boundary.existing_bracket_model: Tracks opener identity and distance for (, [, P, L, quotes and predicts only the matching closer.
parent_overlap_boundary.new_information: Stores bounded transformed XML element names, causally replays the exact top-of-stack name after L/, and learns unanimous next-tag signatures from parent, preceding-event, and depth state.
parent_overlap_boundary.excluded: No raw or transformed reordering, no explicit far-history copy, no target-derived activation, no dictionary replacement, no numeric event coder, and no transmitted side information.

parser.overflow_behavior: emit no state prediction until the suppressed nesting returns to the retained depth
parser.mismatch_behavior: do not pop on a closing-name mismatch
parser.hash: FNV-1a 64-bit over exact transformed name bytes followed by fixed splitmix64 state composition

transition_table.mapping: direct mapped by low ten bits of the composed 64-bit state key
transition_table.state_key: top parent-name hash, previous completed event hash at current depth, and exact depth
transition_table.target: L, optional slash, transformed element name up to sixteen bytes, and N only when contiguous
transition_table.learning: first prior observation installs a target; any different target or key collision permanently poisons that slot

arms.P: No parser or expert; retained parent.
arms.K: Execute identical parsing, table updates, stack operations, and prediction construction with zero injection.
arms.C: Exact causal top-of-stack closing-name replay only.
arms.T: Correct-state unanimous next-tag transition prediction only.
arms.R: Use identical D opportunities and lengths but replace predicted bytes with splitmix64 bytes from the pre-event state key.
arms.D: Union of correct-state transition prediction and exact closing-name replay, with transition predictions taking overlap priority.
arms.S: Train each state on the immediately preceding completed tag signature and use the previously closed name for closure replay.

numeric_policy.diagnostic: Integer byte counts only; no ideal-bit or probability claim is converted to score credit.
numeric_policy.prospective_native_expert: KT-smoothed online reliability assigns mass to the expected byte and uniformly distributes residual mass across the other 255 byte values.
numeric_policy.strength_selection: No hand-tuned blend strength; the unchanged parent mixer must learn any native expert weight at its original call sites.
